data.title: Add shell completions
data.body:
## Goal

Generate shell completions for bash, zsh, and fish.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket completions bash` outputs bash completion script
- [ ] `docket completions zsh` outputs zsh completion script  
- [ ] `docket completions fish` outputs fish completion script
- [ ] Command names complete on TAB
- [ ] Subcommand options complete on TAB
- [ ] Bug IDs complete for commands that take them
- [ ] Document installation in README

## Context

Shell completions significantly improve CLI usability. Clap has built-in support via `clap_complete` crate.

Example installation:
```bash
# Bash
docket completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/docket

# Zsh  
docket completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_docket

# Fish
docket completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/docket.fish
```

High priority: small effort, big UX improvement.
